因此“candidate driver genes”的表述是合适的，但应避免暗示已验证因果驱动作用。
建议将结论措辞调整为：“These are lineage-correlated candidate driver genes, identified by CellRank fate probability association; causal driver status remains to be validated by independent perturbation.”
